name: agent-container-toolchain
description: Pinned, lockfile-controlled global CLI toolchain shared by the claude/codex/opencode container images. Installed via `npm ci` for bit-for-bit reproducible npm tarballs (integrity-verified). Do not add `^`/`~` ranges here — exact versions only; regenerate package-lock.json inside node:24 after any change. The agent CLIs themselves live under tools/agents/<agent>/ so each image installs only its own.
